Lemma
[Sublevel-set derivatives (Lemma 27.31)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0040 ↗ prop:chow-iv-coarea 1. ch27:27.31\group Volume growth

For $V(c)=\operatorname {Vol}\{ f<c\} $ and $\mathcal R(c)=\int _{\{ f<c\} }R$, at regular values $V'(c)=\int _{f=c}| abla f|^{-1}$ and $\mathcal R'(c)=\int _{f=c}R| abla f|^{-1}$. Integration of $R+\Delta f=n/2$ also gives \[ rac n2V(c)-\mathcal R(c)=\int _{f=c}| abla f|, \]
